_doc: Names excluded from the coverage denominator (D-032 d). Every entry needs a reason. Keys are surface names; '*' entries apply to every name of that kind in the surface.

np.get_include: C-extension header path; no Python C API
np.frompyfunc: returns an object-dtype ufunc; no object_ dtype (D-032 a) — use vectorize
np.nested_iters: Python iterator protocol over nditer internals
np.getbufsize: ufunc buffer size tuning; numera ufuncs are unbuffered
np.setbufsize: ufunc buffer size tuning; numera ufuncs are unbuffered
np.little_endian: platform byte order constant; numera is little-endian only
np.memmap: memory-mapped files: deferred, needs its own decision
np.busdaycalendar: covered by busday* functions' holidays/weekmask options
np.flatiter: Python iterator type; exposed as NDArray.flat
np.broadcast: Python broadcast iterator object; use broadcastShapes/broadcastArrays
np.longdouble: aliases float64 (D-032 b); not counted as separate
np.clongdouble: aliases complex128 (D-032 b); not counted as separate
np.record: numpy.record scalar type; covered by rec surface
np.void: structured scalar type; covered by structured dtype support
np.datetime_data: returns Python tuple of unit metadata; covered by datetime64 dtype

ndarray.getfield: raw field views of arbitrary offsets; deferred to structured dtypes
ndarray.setfield: raw field views of arbitrary offsets; deferred to structured dtypes
ndarray.device: array-API device attribute; numera is CPU-only
ndarray.to_device: array-API device transfer; numera is CPU-only

RandomState.tomaxint: removed in NumPy 2 docs; platform C-long dependent

testing.*constant: platform/build flags of the Python test environment
testing.check_support_sve: CPU feature probe for NumPy's own tests
